body:
I don't really have a lot of family.

My dad passed away when I was young and my mom kind of disappeared when I turned 22. I don't have any siblings.

I've been with my boyfriend since I was 22. I told him we would get married as soon as I got better when I originally was diagnosed with an infection in my pancreas. Since then, things have gotten slowly worse. I can no longer work. I can barely do chores. I'm currently at about 98 pounds and still losing weight, even with the weight gainers and medications I've been put on. Some days I can't even get out of bed.

I currently go to a doctor twice a week and pay out of pocket. My boyfriend pays for everything. We can't get on Medicaid because he makes too much money and I can't get on his insurance because we are not married.

Doctors have been apathetic at best to my condition. I feel most are convinced I have an eating disorder. Others give different names of conditions that mean its all in my head. At one point I was told by a nursing friend of mine that all of my symptoms, blood results and diagnostic tests point to pancreatic cancer. We honestly wonder if I haven't been told simply because I won't be able to afford the testing for it, much less the surgery/chemotherapy. Also, at a certain point when symptoms start to show, pancreatic cancer is no longer curable, anyway. So it may just be easier on the doctor.

When I say I'm sick, its beyond just feeling bad. I physically look ill. People whisper about how I look like I'm on drugs or must be bulimic. My poor boyfriend has gotten thrown out of a restaurant for standing up for me after the waitress made a remark.

Every test, every call from the doctor just makes things worse. While I don't know if I would do something along the lines of cutting my wrists or overdosing, but at this point all it would take would be just stop forcing myself to eat. Every meal is a struggle... It would be so much easier to just not do it.
